title: ADRMS — Automated Demand Response Management System

scenes.say: Every fifteen minutes, a state grid is billed for every megawatt it misses. This is ADRMS: demand response, run end to end.
It watches the grid every second: frequency, area control error, and the deviation charge building up.
When a shortfall opens, it explains the situation and proposes a plan, in plain language.
The plan follows a strict priority. Batteries first. Then industrial flexibility. Then everything else.
Every megawatt is tracked as planned versus measured, because an instruction is not a reduction.
Before anything is dispatched, a digital twin screens the plan against line limits, battery charge and response time.
Industries take part through offers, on their own window, response time and price.
Delivery is verified against a metered baseline, and only verified energy is paid.
Only what is left is rotated: fairly, within spell limits, keeping hospitals and water works on, and never without approval.
Operators can test any shortage first: no action, flexibility first, or rotation.
Afterwards, every event settles against a counterfactual ledger, with a tamper-evident audit trail.
ADRMS. Batteries first, industry next, rotation last, with the operator in control.
